subject: Implement nightly delegation_output retention pruning
description:
Build `capo/memory/retention.py` — nightly job that deletes `delegation_output` chunks older than `retention.delegation_output_days` (default 7d) and runs `wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` to reclaim WAL space.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Job scheduled to run once per day (e.g., at local 03:00).
- [ ] Deletes from `delegation_output` where `ts < NOW() - retention.delegation_output_days`.
- [ ] After delete, runs `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` against `state.db`.
- [ ] Job is single-instance (no overlapping runs).
- [ ] Holds DB size growth < 100 MB/week with default retention (per §6.1).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Retention job interrupted mid-run by Capo restart: next run picks up where it left off (idempotent delete).
- [ ] Delegation older than retention but still `running`: chunks are pruned only after delegation reaches a terminal state (or chunks are explicitly preserved while running — choose preserve).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: insert chunks dated > retention; run job; assert deletion + WAL truncation
• Integration: chunks for `running` delegations preserved

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 6.1, 9.5, 15.3
